name: Srijan R Shetty
text:
On Bangerlore.

Was it performative? Probably.

Was there gatekeeping? Maybe.

It was a lame party full of lame people having lame fun.

You should definitely host a better party with better people, and better vibes.

That being said,

You don't need to second-guess everything;…
quote: On Bangerlore. Was it performative? Probably. Was there gatekeeping? Maybe. It was a lame party by any conventional definition. And yet it was one of the best nights of the year.
